summary.text: Gregory Ward is an independent write-in candidate for Maine's 2nd Congressional District, as listed by Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Ran as an Independent for Maine House of Representatives District 148 in 2014, receiving 14.6% (506 votes) in the general election.
Is running in 2026 as an Independent write-in candidate for U.S. House in Maine's 2nd District.
